hook: Retired Hyderabad cops get *Rs 1.5 lakh*-a-month corporate jobs
hook_b: Retired Hyderabad cops get *Rs 1.5 lakh*-a-month corporate jobs
tldr: Real estate, finance, security, education and healthcare firms are hiring retired police officials for second careers, Telangana Today reports.

beats.what: They handle negotiations, dues recovery, pilferage prevention and internal issues; IG-rank and above are hired as advisers.
beats.why: Employers value their administrative, law-and-order and crisis experience and their contact networks, HR managers say.
beats.care: It shows which skills companies pay for: crisis handling, negotiation and networks.

causes.label: Firms want crisis and admin skills

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: A former ACP now works as a legal consultant for a real estate company.

cards.q: Should retired officers face a cooling-off period before corporate jobs?

qs: What rules apply to retired officers taking private jobs?

facts.t: One retired DSP got *3* company offers before superannuation.

viz.verdict: Hiring starts before officers leave service

watch: Watch which sectors keep hiring: real estate and security lead the list.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Retired Hyderabad police officials land corporate jobs with salaries of Rs 1.5 lakh and more

fact: Retired Hyderabad cops are landing corporate roles paying *Rs 1.5 lakh+* a month
twist: Firms now approach officers months before retirement; one DSP had three offers before superannuation.
